title: Candidates are lining up to be the next top HASC Republican. - Breaking Defense
html:
Rep. Mike Rogers of Alabama has said he won’t be seeking a waiver to remain as the top Republican on the House Armed Services Committee, setting up a leadership contest between Reps. Trent Kelly of Mississippi and Ronny Jackson of Texas. Both have military experience and close ties to President Donald Trump.

In this episode of The Congressional Roundup, Breaking Defense Editor-in-Chief Aaron Mehta breaks down the upcoming race and what it could mean for the committee’s traditionally bipartisan approach — as expected incoming Chairman Rep. Adam Smith, D-Wash., considers investigations into Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and the Pentagon.
summary: With Democrats preparing to take control of the House Armed Services Committee, a Republican leadership race could shape the next round of Pentagon oversight.
